name: Maials (Spain)
description: Green field with the middle vertical third formed of nine equal vertical stripes, five yellow and four green.
history: The official flag of Maials is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, divided into three equal vertical stripes, the first and third green and the middle one formed of nine equal vertical stripes, five yellow and four green; approved on 4 September 1995 and published in the DOGC on 25 September 1995.

features.role: middle third of nine narrow stripes, five yellow and four green
